notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33976270/a07c454d4f2fbefdb02acec078f30c0c93b8dd5d.jpg

New Update:

Added Story mode to Strike of Horror.

In the Story Mode your goal is to escape the hunter house.

While escaping the house you will encounter alot of puzzles that you need to solve while being chased by a ghost.

You have limited light source which you need to use efficiently.

Ligh sources:

Flashlight
Lighter
Night Vision Camera

Minimum Players: 2

Maximum Players: 10

Play at your own risk!!!!

Strike of Horror is an online multiplayer horror game.
You start by selecting a team of either being a ghost or a human.

Human Objective:
You need to gather 3 sleeping potions to sleep through the horror, and while gathering make sure that the ghost doesn't catch you.

Ghost Objective:
You need to capture as many humans as possible.

Note: The teams will swap at the second round.

Enjoy Scaring your friends.

Hints:
1) Try to capture your friends from behind to Jump Scare them.
2) Human is faster than ghost.
